players.product: Antminer bitcoin mining machines (S21, S21 Pro, S21 Hydro, T21; U3S21EXPH direct-to-chip liquid-cooled servers)

connects_to.relationship: Bitcoin mining machines (Antminer T21 / S21 / S21 Pro / S21 Hydro) purchased by Keel

contracts.signal: Keel's 10-K: in the first quarter of 2024 the company ordered 19,369 Bitmain T21 Miners, 3,975 Bitmain S21 Miners and 762 Bitmain S21 Hydro Miners (the March 2024 Purchase Order) for $51,285, $13,608 and $4,338 (US$ thousands) respectively, with deliveries scheduled from April 2024 to November 2024; in November 2024 it amended the order and upgraded 12,853 Bitmain T21 Miners to 12,853 S21 Pro Miners for $22,654 (US$ thousands). As of December 31, 2025 all miners on the order were received and the equipment prepayment amount was nil.
contracts.units: 19,369 T21, 3,975 S21 and 762 S21 Hydro miners; 12,853 T21 upgraded to S21 Pro
